name: Butler
notes: Butler is a personal AI assistant that researches options, makes phone calls to businesses, sends emails after approval, creates Google Calendar events (including from emails forwarded to butler@trybutler.xyz) and completes supported web tasks, stopping for login, payment or checkout. Requested via the form (issue #178).
tagline: Not a to-do app. A to-done app.

access.price: Free credits to start · Starter (200 credits/mo) · Pro (500 credits/mo) · one-time packs; dollar prices shown only in the App Store
